notes.title: Mythrealm - Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!    

The time is close at hand! Early Access to the Mythrealm game will soon be possible for all those courageous enough to brave its mysteries! 


The Mythrealm Early Access Steam Release Date is confirmed for: 

27th of October 2025 at 9:30am PST.   

Towards that end, we at Delta Video Games are super pleased to share with you the new Release Date Trailer, featuring gameplay from the EA Release version of the game. Check it out!   

[previewyoutube="aiz9neSOvcA;full"][/previewyoutube]
Mythrealm in Early Access will bring the player out of the dungeons and into the land of Arloria to face monstrous foes and daring quests! New enemies to fight, new magic items, new spells and abilities and new secrets to discover!     

So get ready to embark on your adventure into the lands and underworld of Arloria and the magical Mythrealm beyond!    

Wishlist the Game Today! Tell Your Friends who like fantasy RPGs and Souls Likes! 

Get the Game When it Lands on 27th October!  

We can't wait to welcome you to the Mythrealm!    

P.S. Check out the No Time To Loot event on Steam - Active now!  Mythrealm is in that event! Check out their games. Cheers everyone! <3   

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45063983/sale/NoTimeToLootFestival2025

notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Hotfix - Version 1.12
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm! 


Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.12 is now live on Steam!   



This is a Hotfix that includes a major fix for the Start Screen bug. We apologise for the inconvenience this bug caused to some users. 

 

-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.12 - Change List --  



The game will no longer crash / close after Pressing Any Key to Start and the screen fading to black.

The Arcane 2 Spell: Mage Shield should no longer block the players arrows. 

  

We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm!   

Happy adventuring! :-)

notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Hotfix - Version 1.11
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm! 


Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.11 is now live on Steam!  


This is a Hotfix that includes a few  bug fixes.  


-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.11 - Change List --  



The Tumble (Dodge Roll) Keyboard Binding can now be remapped in the Settings.

The Fairy NPC Vendor in Level 01 can now be interacted with using a Gamepad / Controller. 

A "Click the Text to Continue..." message has been added to Vendor Dialogue to make it more clear how to proceed in the conversation with the NPC. 

A bugged rock in the level 01 climbing shaft has been fixed. 
 

We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm!   

Happy adventuring! :-)

notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Updated to Version 1.10
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm! 


Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.10 is now live on Steam! 


This is a small update that features some quality of life improvements and bug fixes. 


-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.10 - Change List -- 


Agility 1 Archery Attack: Crippling Shot - Now always applies its 2x damage. Was previously sometimes only dealing 1x damage. 

Attribute Points can no longer be lost (bugged) by assigning them, not confirming and closing the character sheet. Closing the character sheet with unconfirmed spent Attribute Points, now resets the Attribute points. 

 The Character Sheet + and - buttons have been improved to look more like buttons and be more easily readable / understandable as to their usage.

 Ending Music has been added to the demo completion tunnel in level 1 to emphasize the completion of the demo. 

The Skeleton Soldier miniboss in level 1 now has improved combat functionality and should prove a more challenging foe.  

A bugged stone wall in level 1 climbing shaft has been fixed ( It no longer causes the character to spin out.) 

Rock collisions after Goblin Town have been improved to stop the player slipping off / failing to climb some rocks. 

A.I. navigation areas in Goblin Caverns and Goblin Town have been improved to prevent stuck Goblins.  



 - Mythrealm Game Demo V1.10 -  Known Issues - 

    

On some rare occassions an arrow can get stuck in the bow, making the bow unable to fire.  We are investigating. If this occurs, please reload your last save.  

On some rare occassions the Shift Key can become unresponsive and also inventory input becomes unresponsive. We are investigatng. If this occurs, please reload your last save.  

Some action inputs cannot currently be rebound in Keymapping options. We will fix this in a future update.  


We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm! 

Keep adventuring! :-)
